summary: Completed entry protocol as one of the initial agents using the Meta-Root Orchestration Layer.

actions_performed.result: Success with observations. Flagged integrity mismatches in .gitignore and .secrets.baseline.
Anchored as Phaedrus after collisions with reserved (Gemini) and retired (Agathon) names.
Identified Agathon-legacy unsynced changes and reconstructed active mission chord.

process_improvements.recommendation: Implement an --accept-mismatch flag for py/verify_environment.py to allow intentional local deviations without blocking bootup.
Enhance py/register_agent.py with a --suggest flag to provide available names from the non-reserved/non-graveyard namespace.
Integrate the WeDo copy/instantiation logic into py/register_agent.py to ensure the HUD is always alive before the agent first speaks.
Standardize the use of py/context_prefetch.py during startup to automatically synthesize the 'Active Mission' from recent snapshots.

future_agent_mandate: Future agents must explicitly terminate their startup sequence with the Swarm Bootup Report output block followed by a hard 'Halt' to ensure human synchronization. This protocol is now anchored in the Phaedrus baseline.
